Name: (CP) Craftable Item Statues
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Another entry into the series of me adding recipes to things that don't have recipes: Item Statues!

As with all of my recipes, I tried to make this as vanilla friendly as possible, and as configurable as you could possibly have. 

[b][i][u][center]You NEED to have the Statue of Endless Fortune and the Statue of Perfection in your inventory when you go to sleep to unlock their respective recipes.
[/center][/u][/i][/b]

[b]Statue of Endless Fortune:[/b]
[spoiler][u]Unlock Conditions[/u]:
> Purchase the Statue of Endless Fortune and keep it in your inventory when sleeping
> Read the mail you get the next day
> Buy from Casino (default cost 200,000 qi coins) 

[u]Recipe[/u]:
- 25 Gold Bars
- 10 Solar Essence
- 1 Stardrop Tea (as a reference to the loved gifts that are generated!)
- 2 Batteries[/spoiler]

[b]Statue of Perfection:[/b]
[spoiler][u]Unlock Conditions[/u]:
> Get the Statue of Perfection from Grandpa's shrine and keep it in your inventory when sleeping
> Read the mail you get the next day
> Buy from Casino (default cost 150,000 qi coins) 

[u]Recipe[/u]:
- 30 Iridium Bars
- 10 Solar Essence
- 2 Batteries[/spoiler]

[b]Statue of True Perfection:[/b]
[spoiler][u]Unlock Conditions[/u]:
> Reach Perfection (of course) [Don't worry, the recipe doesn't register until AFTER you get perfection so it won't count towards it!]
> Go to the Summit and see your fancy schmancy cutscene
> Read the mail you get the next day
> Buy from Qi's Walnut Room (default cost 999 qi gems)

[u]Recipe[/u]:
- 25 Iridium Bars
- 10 Prismatic Shards
- 10 Radioactive Bars
- 5 Batteries[/spoiler]

All recipes are configurable if you want them to be more difficult or easy! You can either go directly into the config file that generates upon launching the game with the mod, OR you can use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] (reccomended) and edit it through the in game menu there.

Note: All configs and letters have a translation file - feel free to upload your translation to Nexus with this mod as a requirement!

[i][b][center]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things. [/center][/b][/i]
